newsitem.title: USA: Eveready Battery sets $60 mln expansion.
newsitem.headline: Eveready Battery sets $60 mln expansion.

text.p: Eveready Battery Co said Monday it plans to spend $60 million to expand production of alkaline batteries at its plants in Maryville, Mo., Asheboro, N.C. and at its operations in Singapore and Tianjin, China.

The expansion program will begin immediately and is expected to meet the growing worldwide demand for batteries including its three fastest growing cell sizes AA, AAA and AAAA, the company said in a statement.
Eveready Battery, a subsidiary of Ralston Purina Co, is the world's largest manufacturer of dry cell batteries and flashlights.
The expansion project was approved by Ralston's directors in November and will be substantially completed over the next years, the company said.
